a: Fail fast if TCP connect cannot complete.
Fail if the server stops sending response data.
Cap overall request duration including retries.
Do not blindly retry POST without idempotency keys.
Stop calling a failing dependency for a cooldown period.
Reuse connections; size pools to match concurrency.
Be aware of DNS TTLs and refresh behavior in long-lived processes.
Never disable TLS verify in production.
Honor HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY when required by environment.
Set a clear User-Agent for support and allowlisting.
